categories.description: System Monitor has stopped producing usable metric snapshots.
CPU usage crossed a sustained alert boundary.
Memory usage crossed a sustained alert boundary.
Connection counts are high or show sustained leak-shaped growth.
GPU usage crossed a sustained alert boundary.
Paging and stall evidence indicates elevated or critical memory pressure.
Agent processes are orphaned or holding substantial unreaped resources.
An owner-attributed process group has sustained high CPU use.
GPU-capable work appears to be using CPU with fresh device evidence.
An owner reports heavy durable work with no live server-side waiter; the alert is report-only.
An owner-attributed monitor alert has not been acknowledged within ten minutes; the five-minute evaluator sustain opens this reminder by minute fifteen.
Disk usage crossed an escalation band.
A monitored storage root began growing quickly or returned to a normal rate.
System Monitor started an investigation for an alert.
